status: inactive design and mock-validated decision engine; deployment gate closed

sole_hardware_owner.owner: static native guardian started by SquashFS PID1 after pivot and before exec systemd
sole_hardware_owner.readback_required: Exact timeout 40 and pretimeout 0, WDIOF_MAGICCLOSE/KEEPALIVEPING/SETTIMEOUT/PRETIMEOUT, sole open succeeds
sole_hardware_owner.vendor_change_required: In LEON_SYSTEMD_RC, start_hw_wdt must query authenticated native guardian ownership and never launch wdtctl -d. Preserve ASUS software watchdog daemon.
sole_hardware_owner.rc_patch_reservation: 0019; not implemented or compiled by this candidate

handoff.point: After successful pivot and before final exec; static guardian is loaded from immutable old SquashFS, using the new root and moved /dev and /run
handoff.parent: PID1 only; root-owned immutable executable and policy must be verified before child launch
handoff.transport: Private AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET socketpair, guardian FD3; parent end FD_CLOEXEC, no inherited duplicate held by other processes
handoff.armed: Two phase: PREPARED_UNARMED follows bounded 15-second read-only preflight. No hardware open is possible before nonce-bound ARM_REQUEST. Then ARMED exact timeout 40 must arrive within 3 seconds.
handoff.exec_success: EOF at guardian control FD starts nonextendable 300-second startup deadline; no unit-start dependency
handoff.exec_failure: While parent still owns preexec FD, send nonce-bound ABORT_PREEXEC. Only confirmed hardware disable and ABORTED authorize rollback mounts and vendor exec.
handoff.abort_failure: Unknown state after ARM_REQUEST or failed abort requires direct emergency reboot syscall, never normal services shutdown or vendor watchdog. Any already armed watchdog remains backup.
handoff.unexpected_parent_close: Treat like exec: require verified health before startup deadline, never silently disarm

health.clock: Guard-owned CLOCK_BOOTTIME, not wall clock or peer timestamps; regression fails closed
required_local: Actual authenticated ASUS manager ready response bound to current PID/starttime/boot and selected board profile; process existence alone is insufficient
Real successful native OpenSSH authentication using an explicit dedicated trial credential or selected migrated admin; listening port alone is insufficient
Native LAN interface/address and expected bridge/backhaul profile are operational
health.required_external: External LAN observer must successfully authenticate to native SSH and submit exact current boot nonce plus increasing sequence over a constrained authenticated acknowledgement path. Local loopback cannot prove LAN accessibility.
health.trust_boundary: Local collector native namespace, root peer credentials, pinned executable inode and bounded requests; external acknowledgement additionally binds the approved account and real sshd session ancestry/remote LAN endpoint. These adapters remain to implement and validate.
health.replay: Wrong boot nonce, zero/duplicate/regressing sequences and peer timestamps cannot refresh leases
health.after_ready: Continue all checks indefinitely through the trial; first explicit failed check or expired lease latches expiry. Healthy does not mean accepted and never writes boot metadata.
health.intentional_disable: Trial requires management SSH enabled. An intentional SSH shutdown ends this trial through a separate explicit operator workflow; no silent relaxation is implemented.

failure.action: Latch failure, retain open watchdog FD, cease keepalives and await hardware expiry; never run normal shutdown, whose driver shutdown callback stops WDT
failure.service_restart: No systemd Restart=always or automatic guardian replacement; failure cannot obtain a fresh startup deadline
failure.signals: SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP latch expiry and retain ownership. SIGKILL unexpectedly releases fd; current core gives one final ping then leaves active timer, subject to physical proof and no competing opener.
failure.budget: Nominal reset no later than startup deadline plus accepted hardware timeout, with a bounded preexec phase. BCM interrupt/time-left quirks and physical reset must be separately measured.
failure.metadata: RO metadata partitions prevent ordinary rc auto-commit, not raw whole-disk writes or privileged BLKROSET. Trial slot must differ from verified committed known-good slot and one-shot next-boot choice must be read back.
failure.guardian_lifetime: Preexec child remains in init.scope after systemd startup in the fixture; production must prevent service stop/cgroup cleanup/reexec from restarting or silently disabling it. QEMU does not prove hardware shutdown ordering.
